January.origin: The month to eat a lot due to abundance of food

February.origin: Signifies a time where elephants are born

March.origin: Elephants are fully grown at this time

April.origin: Autumn sets in. It is cold and there is need for domestic fire

June.origin: Aloe is thriving; soil is more on the dry side

Saturday.origin: meaning last encounter or closure. Derived from this being the designated day for burials

Nail.meaning: To hit the nail on the head

Take.meaning: To take what does not belong to you forcefully

Pass.meaning: To pass people without greeting or acknowledgement

Right.meaning: To do the right thing/ to do something right

Loyal.meaning: To be loyal to a cause

News.meaning: To keep calm in the face of unpleasant news

ownership.swa: ya-(insert owner here (singular use case)), ta-/ a-/ sa-/ ba-/ kwa-(plural use case, depending on first character of object's name)

location.swa: e-(insert place here), se-(if you're trying to convey where something or someone is PRESENTLY), ngase-(if you're using the place as a relativity point to convey direction or location)

objects.swa: i-(for singular), ti- /ema- (for plural, use one or the other depending on context), bo-(plural for people or animals)

nouns.swa: _ (people's names/ titles aren't preceded by anything, you just say the name/title)

With.swa: Na-(insert person's name here), Ne-(insert object here), Nge-(insert object with which an action was performed here)

Wail.Pronunciation: whol-oh-lah (pronounce the first syllable like in “wholesale”

Whomever.swa: Lolo-(insert past tense of verb here)
